title: sp1demo
tagline: Simple SP1 demo proving correct evaluation of the paraboloid of equation: z = f(x, y) = x² + y²
description: SP1 is a performant and "clean" zkVM running a (slightly modified) RISC-V ISA implemented in Rust by Succinct Labs. Succinct offer a hosted compute solution, Succinct Prover Network. At Frontiers 2024, Succinct demonstrated verification of real Ethereum blocks, costing to the order of a cent.
